benefit: Calendula's resinous open flowers attract hoverflies, lacewings, and parasitic wasps. A row of calendula at every 30 to 40 ft of bed length supplies beneficials across the season. Strong dual-purpose for herbal-product growers.

members.title: Calendula plug every 30 to 40 ft of bed
members.body: Transplant calendula plugs every 30 to 40 ft along bed centerlines. Deadhead weekly through season for continuous bloom.
